heroSubtitle: Order online, pay only once you've received the item and checked that everything's right
step1Desc: Pick products from the catalog and place your order on the site or via the Telegram bot
step2Desc: A manager confirms your order and works out the pickup/delivery details
step3Desc: Pick it up yourself or wait for delivery — whichever suits you
step4Desc: Cash, no prepayment, no hidden fees
pickupDesc: Pick up your order whenever it's convenient — the manager will confirm the address and time.
deliveryDesc: We'll bring your order anywhere in Uzbekistan. Cost and timing depend on the region and are confirmed when your order is placed.
paymentDesc: Pay only after you've received the item and checked that everything's right — no prepayment, no hidden fees.
faq1A: Right now we only accept cash on receipt of the order.
faq2A: It depends on the region and order size — the manager will confirm it when your order is confirmed, before you pay anything.
faq3Q: How fast will my order arrive?
faq3A: Timing depends on stock availability and your region — we'll confirm it right after you place the order.
faq4Q: Can I inspect the item before buying?
faq4A: Yes, with pickup you can inspect the item on the spot before paying.
ctaSubtitle: Get in touch — we'll help you choose the best way to receive your order
